messages.text: Hi, do you ship to Canada?

Yes, we ship to Canada.

Worth knowing: miners come with region-specific plugs and voltage, so your unit ships from the North American warehouse with a US/Canada plug. We can't cross-ship between regions.

Is there a particular miner you're looking at? I'll check live stock and the ship date for it.
The NerdQaxe++, does it come with a Canadian plug?
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner (postal code ····)/s

It comes in a US plug, which is what you'd want in Canada — but that variant is out of stock right now. Only the UK version is available, and we can't send that to you; wrong plug and voltage.

Honestly, the BC04 is the better buy anyway: same 6 TH/s, $239, in stock with the plug matched to your address, and ~100W instead of ~150W. The NerdQaxe++ only wins on open-source firmware and being slightly quieter.

Want me to add the BC04 to your cart?
Great, and how long to Toronto?

It ships from our North American warehouse within 5 business days of ordering. Transit time on top of that I can't quote precisely — the shipping options and estimate show at checkout once your (address hidden) address is in.

If you want the firm delivery window before you commit, I can have someone confirm it for you.

Want me to build the cart so you can see the shipping options?
